entities.summary: Huk Rebellion, a transformative movement in Philippines (1946–1965). Emerged from Bell Trade Act and Third Republic. Catalyzed Marcos declares Martial Law and Benigno 'Ninoy' Aquino Jr. assassinated at Manila airport.
